newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Dutch bourse to halt trade if index falls five pct.
newsitem.headline: Dutch bourse to halt trade if index falls five pct.

text.p: The Amsterdam bourse said that from Thursday it would halt trading in the retail segment of the share market for a 15-minute "cooling-off" period if the AEX share index were to fall five percent in one day.
The cooling-off period will not apply to the professional segment of the market, nor will it be triggered by a five percent rise in the index.
The bourse said the trading halt was part of a broader set of rules for "exceptional market circumstances".
Professional programme-trading will be halted for at least 15 minutes if the index rises or falls by more than two percent in one hour.
Professional trading in "baskets" of the shares which make up the AEX index will also be halted for at least 15 minutes if the index rises or falls by more than two percent in one hour.
